description: Agent Agriculture Records: submit planting and seed records with the crop plan they answer to: each planting the crop plan states with its id, reference, field, crop, variety and the first and last day of its planting window; each seed record with its id, the seed lot reference, crop and variety; each planting record with its id, reference, field, crop, variety, the seed lot used and the moment planted. The signed report gives the plantings and the plan, each planting’s field against a planned planting that covers it, each recorded variety against the variety the plan and the seed record state, each seed lot used against a seed record behind it, and each planting date against the window the plan states, and counts them, and names divergent planting records: a planting recorded on a field the plan does not cover, a variety in the planting record that differs from the plan or the seed record, a seed lot used with no seed record behind it, and a planting recorded outside the window the plan states; then a planting naming no seed lot and a planned planting with no planting record behind it, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No plantings, plantings with no planned plantings beside them, or seed lots named with no seed records beside them leaves those points unverified. Fields and seed lots match by letters and digits, a planting reads under the planned planting on its field and of its crop when both name one, crops and varieties match by their words with plurals folded, and a planting date reads inside its window from the first day to the last, by the day. This reads whether every field was planted as the plan states, with the variety and seed lot on record, inside its window. Verdict agri_planting_divergent, agri_planting_partial, agri_planting_unverified or agri_planting_consistent. POST /api/agri-planting-check. Reads the farm production records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the records as supplied only: it visits no farm, takes no soil or tissue sample, contacts no regulator or certifier and issues no certification, which stay with the operation, its agronomists, its regulators and its certifiers, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Agriculture Records reads a farm operation’s own production records: crop and production plan records, planting and seed records, pesticide and fertilizer application records, irrigation and water-use records, soil test and nutrient records, harvest and yield records, livestock records and field-to-lot traceability records, each against the planting, input application and harvest records, the plan’s fields, varieties and windows and the seed records, the applicator and license records and the pre-harvest intervals, the schedule, the water allocation and the fields the plan lists, the planting and application records, the birth, purchase, movement and treatment records and the herd count, the planting and harvest records and the shipments, or the testing schedule, the fertilizer applications and the nutrient recommendations on record. The family’s ground is the paper trail behind the crop and the herd: what the plan calls for, what the field logs show, what was applied and when, and whether the harvest and the traceability hold up; the Agent Food Safety Records family reads a food business’s safety records downstream, after production, and the Agent Customs Records family reads the border filings for goods, while this family reads the farm’s own records upstream, in the field, and reads neither. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-agriculture-records-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-agriculture-records/.
